facts.fact: BusinessDay reports Vincent Olatunji, national commissioner of the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, speaking at the Lagos summit on how the commission handles an increasing number of data protection cases.
BusinessDay says Nigeria enacted the Data Protection Act in 2023, a legal framework for how organisations collect, process and manage personal information.
BusinessDay quotes the national commissioner of the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, which it says faces a rising number of data protection cases.
